en: Black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view of a long, multi‑storey residential or institutional building with dormer windows and a corner tower-like projection. The structure stands along an unpaved open area or street, with a few people visible in front. At the top in red Gothic-style lettering is a brief caption identifying the location as Torgau on the Elbe River and specifying the street section near the water tower.
